description: Advisory early progression: level 1 Lumo Ruins, level 5 Blood Grove, level 10 Crystal Creek and the second essence slot. Each cell fixes a single spawn; challenge labels are hypotheses, not difficulty guarantees.

stages.name: Starter / level 1
assumptions: First Weapon completed; either weapon is a legal one-handed Arms Chest choice.
One common standard tier-1 rank-0 weapon, Goblin essence at level 1, no ascension or evolution.
No armor, accessories, styles, persistent bonuses or temporary buffs. Fresh single-spawn encounters.

stages.name: Blood Grove entry / level 5
assumptions: Trial of Lumo completed; Blood Grove is accessible. One additional chest piece acquired through ordinary regional equipment drops/rewards.
Both builds budget two common standard tier-1 rank-0 items. Time to acquire specific items is not simulated; this is an explicit ownership hypothesis.
Retain the initial level-1 Goblin essence as a conservative control. No ascension, evolution, accessories, styles or temporary buffs. Fresh single-spawn encounters.

stages.name: Crystal Creek entry / level 10
assumptions: Blood in the Grove completed; Crystal Creek is accessible and the second essence slot has unlocked.
Both builds budget four common standard tier-1 rank-0 items: a two-handed weapon plus head, chest and legs. Acquisition time is not modeled; accessories remain absent.
Goblin Warrior and Vampire Bat essences come from already accessible Lumo Ruins/Blood Grove. All essences remain level 1, unascended and unevolved to isolate slot/composition changes.
No styles, persistent bonuses or temporary buffs. Fresh single-spawn encounters; equal item count does not imply equal combat power.
